description: Search open positions for physiotherapists, occupational therapists and speech and language therapists in Germany. All filters are optional and combined with AND. Returns title, employer, city, postal code, region, employment type and the links to the job page and the application (about one minute, no CV).

location.description: City name or the first digits of a German postal code, e.g. 'Köln' or '50'

profession.description: physiotherapeut = physiotherapist, ergotherapeut = occupational therapist, logopaede = speech and language therapist

query.description: Words from the job title, employer or profession, German or English, e.g. 'Physiotherapeut Neurologie' or 'speech therapist'

name: search_jobs
title: Search jobs
